verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own export paths for transaction data: CSV export of filtered transactions via its MCP server, per-transaction exports with reference ID, timestamp and on-chain hash, statement pulls, and developer APIs covering cards, payments, transactions and expense data. Nothing shows a complete, all-data export or an account exit process, so coverage is limited to financial transaction records. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export (receipts, memos, users, vendors, settings), open-format specs beyond CSV, an account offboarding/closure path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
